correctness.rationale: The categorical cocycle pooling, fiber identification, boundary-groupoid homotopy, Bönicke K-theory invariance, and UCT mapping-cone upgrade form a coherent proof of KK-equivalence. The common total-algebra vertex projection gives the stated K_0 class preservation. The original metadata incorrectly called this a stable-isomorphism theorem, which is stronger than KK-equivalence and was not proved; the repair corrects that label and the artifact paths.

originality.rationale: Much of the theorem is an incremental synthesis of Gillaspy, Bönicke, and Sims-Whitehead-Whittaker plus a standard UCT upgrade. The finitely aligned satiated-relative categorical-to-groupoid bridge and explicit KK/vertex-class formulation are useful, but the mechanism is not wholly new.

value.rationale: The result packages a usable homotopy-invariance statement at the finitely aligned relative level and strengthens a K-isomorphism conclusion to a KK-equivalence under UCT hypotheses. This is scientifically useful even though the advance is incremental.

limitations: Literature comparisons are claim-specific and do not constitute an exhaustive priority proof. GitHub was read only. Computations described as independent were reconstructed from stated finite data or supplied artifacts; no inaccessible paper is claimed as read.
